A FIELD GUIDE TO EXPLORING

Take the scenic route.

Walk
WASD or the up and down arrows. Hold Shift for a quicker pace.
Look
Drag the city, use left and right arrows, or enable mouse look. Escape releases the pointer.
Read
Approach a landmark and press E. The index opens every chapter directly.
Fly above the world
Choose City view or press V. WASD flies, Space rises, C descends, Shift speeds up, and the scroll wheel moves closer. R frames the entire city. On foot returns to where you left off.
Click the city
The moving pieces on each building, such as the tunnel boring machine, the ledger, the telescope, and the project exhibits around the makers’ warehouse, open cards about my work. Cars, boats, people, and animals show what they are up to. In City view, Follow keeps the camera with it. City life is fictional.
Watch the day pass
A full day lasts six minutes and begins at your local time. Windows, shops, and street lamps light up after dusk. Press T or +1h to skip ahead, or pause the clock.
Find your way
Press M or open the city map, choose a destination, then Walk here. WASD or Escape stops the guide. On touch screens, use the direction buttons and drag the scene to look. Return to start at any time. The complete field guide is always available.
